newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenia to change dates for tenders-minister.
newsitem.headline: Armenia to change dates for tenders-minister.

text.p: Armenia has decided to change the dates of open tenders for selling off state-owned stakes of more than 10 major state enterprises, the Economy and Finance Minister said on Thursday.
"We have decided to change the terms of auctions following the request of representatives of these enterprises and some investors," the minister, Armen Darbinyan, told Reuters.
He said that the tenders had been postponed by an average of about 1-1/2 months to two months.
But he said one auction, of a 51 percent stake in the Armentel communications joint-venture, would be brought forwrd to Friday from the previous planned date of October 15.
Armentel JV handles international communications in the former Soviet republic of 3.5 million people.
Darbinyan said that the tender for selling off 80 percent of shares in the Yerevan Cognac Plant would go ahead on October 15.
The Armenian government decided earlier this year to privatise 11 state-owened enterprises. Merrill Lynch International is acting as an advisor to the government on the sales.
